guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Standard / Fender Telecaster / Danelectro
guitar.evidence: Jimmy Page's 1959 Gibson Les Paul ('Number One') is one of the most iconic guitars in rock history, alongside his well-documented use of a Telecaster (Stairway to Heaven solo) and Danelectro for alternate tunings.

tone.target: dry, punchy hard-rock riff tone with upper-mid bite
tone.profile: dry, punchy hard-rock riff tone with upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A classic Marshall Plexi-style chain using a Boost for initial punch, Distortion for grit, and the UK 45 amp paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve the desired dry, biting hard rock tone.
